Episode 2 (Original 85) story overview

Spoiler-free overview

Episode 85 moves the conflict from a frontier plot into a diplomatic confrontation. Mehmed sends an envoy to Tabriz, but the demand for either Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa puts negotiations under severe pressure. Plans for Rome remain vulnerable to a second war.

English viewer context

The demand is a choice between territory and a person: Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa. Gedik Ahmed travels as Mehmed’s envoy, so this mission is a diplomatic effort in the published synopsis. Zeno and Tahrani are working against reconciliation. Keep the ultimatum separate from any final agreement; the linked summary establishes the pressure but does not supply a complete ending recap.

Find the original episode with English captions

Look for Mehmed Fetihler Sultani or the Turkish spelling Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı. Match Season 4 Episode 2 with original Episode 85, then choose English Subtitles on Great Nation. A page labelled Urdu Subtitles or Urdu Dubbed is another edition.

For released episodes, the Niazi link in the guide opens the English entry. Keep that subtitle edition as you use the previous and next episode buttons.

Episode numbering help

What happens in Episode 2 (Original 85)?

Spoiler notice: plot details from published synopses.

  1. An envoy goes to Tabriz

    Mehmed sends Gedik Ahmed to seek a diplomatic response to the Karasu crisis.

  2. Savcu delivers a difficult demand

    Uzun Hasan’s terms call for Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa following Behram’s death.

  3. Peace has opponents

    Zeno and Tahrani work against reconciliation, threatening the preparations for Rome.

These details come from published synopses, not a complete watched recap. The sources do not establish every scene or the ending.

Previous episode context and key characters

Episode 84 introduces the Karasu scheme. Episode 85 follows its political consequences, with the Roman campaign dependent on avoiding an eastern war.

Gedik Ahmed
Mehmed’s envoy to Tabriz.
Savcu
Carries Uzun Hasan’s demand.
Mustafa
The prince named in the ultimatum.

Episode 2 (Original 85): frequently asked questions

Is Season 4 Episode 2 the same as Episode 85?+

Yes. Season 4 Episode 2 maps to overall Turkish Episode 85, also written Bölüm 85. A dubbed release can use a different cut or numbering.

What is the release date for Episode 85?+

The original Turkish broadcast date is 22 September 2026. That date does not establish when the English-subtitled edition was uploaded.

Where can I watch Episode 85 with English subtitles for free?+

Great Nation is our first choice for free viewing with notifications. Open Episode 2 / Bolum 85 and select English Subtitles. The publisher has verified this release.

How do I choose the correct English version?+

Match Season 4 Episode 2 with overall Episode 85, then choose English Subtitles. The Urdu listing is a separate edition and is not evidence that an English track plays.

What is the main demand in Episode 85?+

Karasu Fortress or Prince Mustafa. This demand drives the episode’s diplomatic stakes; the source summaries do not establish the complete ending of the negotiations.
